title: Meadow and onboarding performance on Windows, Android and macOS: find causes, fix without changing the look, ship

completion_criteria.text: On the owner's Windows PC, with a heavily seeded journal, the Meadow page loads, changes time of day and survives several time changes followed by a full-screen toggle without a visible freeze
completion_criteria.check: profile build on WINTERPENGUINS driven over its VM service: frame timings and UI-thread stall windows recorded before and after the fix

completion_criteria.text: The onboarding Meadow animation runs smoothly on macOS, Android and Windows
completion_criteria.check: frame timings of the onboarding animation before and after on each platform (lab Android emulator, lab or host Mac, Windows PC)

completion_criteria.text: The Meadow on Android loads faster than before
completion_criteria.check: scene-ready time on the lab Android emulator before and after

completion_criteria.text: The Meadow and onboarding look exactly as before, quality included
completion_criteria.check: Meadow and onboarding goldens unchanged plus impeller tests pass
completion_criteria.settled_by: Identify the best way to resolve the issue without changing how the meadow (onboarding and page) look today. This include quality.

completion_criteria.text: The fix ships as draft pull requests through the pipeline, none merged

spine.active_goal: Find why the Meadow page loads and changes time of day slowly on Windows (and freezes after several time changes plus a full-screen toggle), why it loads slowly on Android, and why the onboarding Meadow animation is slow and choppy on every platform; fix each cause without changing how either looks (quality included), test on the owner's Windows PC with a heavily seeded journal, and ship through the pipeline as draft PRs.
spine.next_step: Read lib/features/garden/scene/meadow_stage.dart, meadow_pacer.dart, meadow_scene_cache.dart and lib/features/onboarding/chapters/garden_scene.dart to map the load, recolour and onboarding paths, then install Flutter 3.47.5 on the Windows PC and measure a profile build there.

key_decisions.title: Meadow pacing fix: cap snapshot renders per frame gap, honest after-batch readback marker, builds fill the cap, frame-free first build
